title: AgentMeasure Commerce Profile (v0.1)
description: F2.1-F2.3/F2.7: the record envelope for agent-commerce measurement — the chain where the click disappears. One record = one fact on the Invocation -> Order -> Payment -> Refund chain, or one agent decision observation. Discipline baked in at the schema layer: live / replay / synthetic observation modes are DISTINCT values and must never be mixed inside one aggregation (synthetic lab probes entering a production aggregate is the exact mistake most GEO tools make); every record carries the measurement_policy_version it was collected under (governance 1); decision observations record OBSERVED merchants, never a candidate_set — a black-box platform does not show the full candidate set and pretending otherwise is fabrication (F2.2).

observation_mode.description: live: production, happened. replay: re-processed production records. synthetic: controlled experiment (Experiment Lab probes). Modes are segregated at aggregation time; a synthetic record inside a live aggregation is an error, not a blend.

measurement_policy_version.description: Governance 1: the versioned, public methodology this record was collected and will be judged under. Mixed policy versions inside one aggregation are refused.

platform.description: decision_observation: the agent platform that made the decision (as observed, never inferred).

query_family.description: decision_observation: the family of the user query (e.g. 'best CRM for dentists'), never the raw query text.

observed_merchants.description: F2.2: merchants OBSERVED in the answer or action. Deliberately NOT named candidate_set: a black-box platform does not expose the full candidate set, and a field named candidate_set invites fabricating one.

selected_entity.description: decision_observation: the merchant/entity the agent actually acted on, if any.

stated_rationale.description: decision_observation: the rationale the agent STATED. A stated rationale is a fact about the statement; it is never treated as the causal reason (F2.6).

operation_id.description: The commercial intent: one user-facing goal (one operation).

attempt_id.description: One agent decision run towards the operation. A retry is a NEW attempt under the SAME operation — never a second operation.

idempotency_key.description: Merchant-side key that collapses retries; two orders sharing one key are one order, whatever the request log says.

evidence_level.description: F2.3: observed = both records exist and share a key; correlated = amount+time window agree without a shared key; inferred = only one record claims the link; UNPROVABLE = no link evidence. Metric strength must never exceed this level (F2.6).

rule_basis.description: Which named rule assigned the evidence level — every grade is attributable.
